scripts.install-all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build:production: cd frontend && npm run build -- --mode production
scripts.build:staging: cd frontend && npm run build -- --mode staging
scripts.network-info: echo "🌐 Network Access URLs:" && LOCAL_IP=$(ip route get 8.8.8.8 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $7; exit}' || ifconfig 2>/dev/null | grep -Eo 'inet (addr:)?([0-9]*\.){3}[0-9]*' | grep -Eo '([0-9]*\.){3}[0-9]*' | grep -v '127.0.0.1' | head -1 || echo 'localhost') && echo "Frontend: http://$LOCAL_IP:3000" && echo "Backend: http://$LOCAL_IP:5000"
scripts.check-deployment: echo "🔍 Checking deployment readiness..." && node -e "console.log('Node version:', process.version); console.log('Environment:', process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development');"
scripts.render-info: echo "🚀 Render.com Deployment Info:" && echo "Backend: https://finautojobs-backend.onrender.com" && echo "Frontend: https://finautojobs-frontend.onrender.com" && echo "Health: https://finautojobs-backend.onrender.com/api/health"
